title: 查找共用字符
summary: 返回字符串数组中所有字符串都出现的字符，重复次数取各字符串出现次数的最小值，顺序任意。
insight: 维护二十六个字符的全局最小频次；每个单词单独计数后逐位取最小，最后按频次输出字符。
pitfalls: 初始最小频次可设为很大或首词频次

solutions.title: 字符最小频次
solutions.idea: 逐词收紧每个字母可共同出现的次数。
steps: 对每个 word 统计 frequency[26]，再令 minimum[i]=min(minimum[i],frequency[i])
按 a 到 z，把每个字符重复 minimum 次加入结果

code.java: class Solution { public List<String> commonChars(String[] words){int[] minimum=new int[26];Arrays.fill(minimum,Integer.MAX_VALUE);for(String word:words){int[] frequency=new int[26];for(char ch:word.toCharArray())frequency[ch-'a']++;for(int i=0;i<26;i++)minimum[i]=Math.min(minimum[i],frequency[i]);}List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<26;i++)for(int count=0;count<minimum[i];count++)answer.add(String.valueOf((char)('a'+i)));return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun commonChars(words:Array<String>):List<String>{val minimum=IntArray(26){Int.MAX_VALUE};for(word in words){val frequency=IntArray(26);for(ch in word)frequency[ch-'a']++;for(i in 0..25)minimum[i]=minOf(minimum[i],frequency[i])};val answer=mutableListOf<String>();for(i in 0..25)repeat(minimum[i]){answer.add(('a'.code+i).toChar().toString())};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<string> commonChars(vector<string>& words){vector<int> minimum(26,INT_MAX);for(string& word:words){vector<int> frequency(26);for(char ch:word)++frequency[ch-'a'];for(int i=0;i<26;++i)minimum[i]=min(minimum[i],frequency[i]);}vector<string> answer;for(int i=0;i<26;++i)for(int count=0;count<minimum[i];++count)answer.push_back(string(1,'a'+i));return answer;} };
